title: Choosing an appointment reminder method
passage:
DOCUMENT 1 — FENWICK SERVICE DESK | Counting rules

An eligible case is a customer request opened during the trial for which the customer agreed to receive reminders. Count one eligible case per request, even if several messages are exchanged about it.

To count as resolved without a repeat contact, a case must be marked solved and the customer must not contact the desk again about the same request by the end of the following business day. Record any reminder sent after a case is closed in a separate column, whether the customer replies or not.

DOCUMENT 2 — PILOT RESULTS | Appointment reminder trial

Read the attached results chart. The three method names refer to three separate sets of eligible cases, not three stages of the same process.

DOCUMENT 3 — INTERNAL EMAIL | Monday's recommendation

Please recommend a method only if it had at least thirty eligible cases, at least three quarters of its eligible cases were resolved without a repeat contact, and it sent no reminders after closure. A high resolution rate does not cancel out a failure on either of the other requirements.

Monday's email to the managers should include the full results chart, not just the row for the method we recommend. The chart is for review: do not change the reminder method used by the service desk until the managers have decided.
passageZh:
文件一 — 芬威克服務中心｜計數規則

符合條件的案件，指在試行期間建立，而且客戶同意接收提醒的服務請求。每項請求只計為一件，即使雙方已為此互傳好幾封訊息。

若要計為「未再聯絡即結案」，案件必須已被標記為解決，且直到下一個工作日結束前，客戶都沒有為同一項請求再次聯絡服務中心。案件結案後若仍寄出提醒，請另列一欄記錄，不論客戶是否回覆。

文件二 — 試行結果｜預約提醒試行

請閱讀所附的結果表。三種方式分別用於三組不同的符合條件案件，不是同一流程的三個階段。

文件三 — 內部郵件｜週一的建議

只有同時符合以下三項條件的方式才可推薦：至少三十件符合條件的案件、其中至少四分之三未再聯絡即結案，以及結案後沒有再發出任何提醒。解決率再高，也不能彌補另外兩項中任何一項未達標。

週一給主管的郵件應附完整結果表，不只是建議採用方式的那一列。表格供主管審查；主管作出決定前，不要更改服務中心實際使用的提醒方式。
